findings.title: Direct external LLM API calls bypass model router

evidence.observation: Direct invocation of call_gemini using GEMINI_API_KEY and call_mistral using MISTRAL_API_KEY instead of routing through the model router service

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM queries through the centralized model router endpoint.

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes model routing, failover, quota management, and access logging.
